{{Quote|You'd be Teeb Markl? I'm Tarnik. Jaklin warned you and your cousin were out to help.|Tarnik, to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Siege" />}}
'''Tarnik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who resided in the village [[Torbel]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]] during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Tarnik was middle-aged and had a scar that ran across both cheeks on his face. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who had ventured to Lanteeb on a [[Battle of Lanteeb|mission]] to destroy a [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]] created by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[General/Legends|general]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]] and was disguised as a [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] under the alias "Teeb Markl", assisted Tarnik with preparing Torbel's defences to weather an approaching [[theta storm]].<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Siege" />
